name: fable5-codex
description: Verify what a coding agent finished, tested and left unverified before merge or handoff.

interface.longDescription: Before merge, map acceptance criteria to exact source revisions, observed checks and remaining unknowns with fable-verify. Quick and deep modes preserve the existing audit, review, fact-check, understanding, design and sweep workflows. Local verification uses versioned artifacts, stale-evidence checks and configurable capability-aware Codex profiles. Semantic judgments, supplied records, installation, activation and deployment remain distinct. Requires local repository access; grants no repair, merge or deployment authority.
defaultPrompt: Use $fable-verify in quick mode: what is finished, tested and still unverified before merge?
Use $fable-understand with an ECF run contract to explain boot flow.
